出了公司，时笙也不说话，让三人上车，陆清韵开车。

江真真的视线就没离开过陆清韵，网上的照片有些模糊，当时她虽然觉得很帅，但是因为时笙的关系，江真真并没有将陆清韵看在眼里。

可是现在见到，她忽然发现这个男人真的好美。

江源和江母坐在后面，两人用他们才懂的眼神交流着。

最后江母先打破沉默，操着长辈的口气，“小晚，你这孩子一个人在外面创业幸苦吧？怎么也不给家里打个电话，我和你大伯也好帮帮你的。”

“不劳吴女士费心，我可不敢麻烦你们。”时笙丝毫没有掩饰语气中的讽刺。

“你这孩子怎么连大伯母都不叫了，你就我们这几个亲人了，什么麻烦不麻烦的。当年你父母去世，不也是我们照顾你？怎么还和大伯母见外了。”

江母语气半嗔半无奈，那样子好像真的有多关心她似的。

但是那眼底的贪婪，却暴露得彻彻底底。

“吴女士这话可不对，我父母去世留下的将近百万的赔偿金，加上他们平日里的积蓄和房子，林林总总加起来也有两百万，这些钱不都被你们拿去了？这些钱就算是你们照顾我那几年的费用，我就不跟你们要了。”

江母被噎得说不出话。

当年要不是看在那些钱的份上，她怎么可能会收养一个拖油瓶。

“好啊江晚，你翅膀硬了是不是？”江源立即出声支援江母，“我们把你养大不花钱吗？你现在有钱了，就想翻脸不认识是不是，你爸爸都还叫我一声哥哥，你连尊卑都不知道了，你爸要是还在，非得被你气死。”

“呵……江先生，你在我身上花了多少钱，我们大家心知肚明，我爸要是知道你是这么对我的，指不定晚上还会上来找你。”

吓唬人的话，谁不会说？

当本宝宝是被吓到的吗？

这一家子都是一个字，贪！

当年原主的父母留下那么多钱，足够原主安稳的读完大学，甚至是创业基金都有了，可是这家人以各种理由哄着原主将那些东西给了他们。

这还不知足，还想把原主卖一个好价钱。

这种人真的是亲戚吗？妈的，是仇人吧！

小说世界除了白莲花绿茶婊，还有渣亲戚这种神奇的生物。

“你……你……”江源被气得说不出话，也有可能是心虚，不知该如何反驳时笙。

After leaving the company, Shi Sheng said nothing and asked the three of them to get in the car while Lu Qingyun drove.

Jiang Zhenzhen's eyes never left Lu Qingyun, and the photos on the Internet were a bit blurry. Although she thought he was handsome at the time, Jiang Zhenzhen didn't take Lu Qingyun seriously because of Shi Sheng.

But now that she saw him, she suddenly realized that this man was really beautiful.

Jiang Yuan and Jiang Mu sat in the back, communicating with eyes that only they understood.

Finally, Jiang's mother broke the silence first and said in an elder's tone, "Xiao Wan, are you lucky to be starting a business outside alone? Why don't you call home so that your uncle and I can help you."

"Ms. Wu, I don't dare bother you." Shi Sheng did not hide the sarcasm in his tone.

"Why don't you, kid, even call me aunt? You only have a few relatives like us, so there is nothing to worry about. When your parents passed away, weren't we the ones who took care of you? Why are you still separated from your aunt?"

Jiang's mother's tone was half angry and half helpless, as if she really cared about her.

But the greed in his eyes was completely exposed.

"Ms. Wu is wrong. The nearly one million yuan in compensation left by my parents after their death, plus their daily savings and house, totals two million. Didn't you take all of this money? This money is considered to be the cost of taking care of me during the years you took care of me, and I won't ask for it from you."

Jiang's mother was choked to the point of being speechless.

If it wasn't for the money, how could she have adopted an oil bottle?

"Okay Jiang Wan, your wings are strong, aren't you?" Jiang Yuan immediately spoke up to support Jiang's mother, "Should we raise you without spending money? Now that you have money, you just want to fall out, don't you know? Your father still calls me brother. You don't even know your dignity. If your father is still here, you will be angry to death."

"Ha...Mr. Jiang, we all know how much money you have spent on me. If my dad knew that you did this to me, he might come to see you at night."

Who wouldn’t say something to scare people?

Is this baby scared?

This family all has one word, greed!

Back then, the original owner's parents left so much money, which was enough for the original owner to finish college safely and even have a start-up fund. However, the family used various reasons to coax the original owner into giving those things to them.

This is not enough, he also wants to sell it to the original owner for a good price.

Are these people really relatives?Damn it, he must be an enemy!

In addition to the white lotus and green tea whore, there are also magical creatures like the scumbag relatives in the world of the novel.

"You...you..." Jiang Yuan was so angry that he couldn't speak. Maybe he felt guilty and didn't know how to refute Shi Sheng.
